name: Pattypan Squash
siboNotes: Well-tolerated for SIBO as it's naturally low in fermentable carbohydrates and easy to digest when cooked.
preparationTips: Steam or roast until tender to improve digestibility
Remove seeds if preparing for sensitive individuals
Can be eaten raw when young and tender
Pairs well with low-FODMAP herbs like basil and oregano
nutritionalHighlights: Low in calories and high in water content
